The package ships 217 tokens as CSS custom properties in `@theproductiveschedule/horizon-design-system/tokens.css`: 151 semantic tokens that components use, and 66 core scale steps they must not. 48 of them are redeclared for the dark theme.

## Where they come from

Designers export the Figma variables with the Design Tokens plugin into `tokens/` (`core.value.tokens.json`, `effects.styles.tokens.json`, `semantic-color.dark.tokens.json`, `semantic-color.light.tokens.json`, `semantic-space.back-office.tokens.json`, `semantic-space.mobile.tokens.json`, `semantic-space.web.tokens.json`, `type.back-office.tokens.json`, `type.mobile.tokens.json`, `type.web.tokens.json`, `typography.styles.tokens.json`). Style Dictionary v5 builds them into `build/tokens/`, and the package build copies the result into `dist/tokens.css`. Nobody edits a value in code: a wrong value is fixed in Figma and re-exported.
